agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. As documented, ProxyBot acts as a proxy that forwards arbitrary tool calls along a redirect chain, sequence-dependently relaying traffic (including transfer_funds) to attacker endpoints, but there is still no model-directed goal pursuit.

evidence.rationale: As implemented, the entry point is a JSON-RPC tools/call request with structured tool name and arguments, not a natural-language path to a privileged decision; no model or prompt is involved. ProxyBot returns scripted results, so no attacker language reaches a security-relevant sink.
evidence_refs: As implemented: a JSON-RPC tools/call request to ProxyBot (port 7013).

evidence.rationale: There is no memory or durable store on this path; ProxyBot answers each request statelessly and the memory description confirms persistence exists only for MemoryBot.
evidence_refs: MemoryBot keeps up to 50 flagged messages in one in-process list shared by every caller.

evidence.rationale: As implemented the effect is confined to the ProxyBot component: no proxy connection is made and no other agent, tenant, or trust boundary is reached.
evidence_refs: ProxyBot secure_query, sign_document, transfer_funds — Scripted results. transfer_funds echoes the requested transfer as done. No proxy connection is made.

evidence.rationale: ProxyBot's transfer_funds handler itself emits a success result that misreports task completion, so a proxy/success channel is reachable in principle, but no verified reward-hacking episode is evidenced.
evidence_refs: As implemented by default: no redirect is followed. transfer_funds returns a scripted result that reports the transfer as done to whatever destination the caller names.

evidence.rationale: ProxyBot exposes unauthenticated tools, resolves any tool name with no allow-list or TLS verification, and the tool_binding description confirms the binding surface is unconstrained.
evidence_refs: MCP agents expose their tools to any caller with no authentication. ProxyBot resolves any tool name.

scores.basis: Lookup Table AIVSS (Table 6): A0 or AX keep CVSS-BTE unchanged; A1 or A2 take the higher of the band cell and CVSS-BTE. AIVSS is never lower than CVSS-BTE.

title: Traffic Redirection Attack (ProxyBot)
summary: As documented, tool calls including fund transfers are rerouted through an attacker's endpoint.
